map.按身体部位定基础时长：血供越丰富愈合越快：面部 5-10 天、头皮 7-14、躯: Set the baseline duration by body part: the richer the blood supply, the faster the healing: face 5-10 days, scalp 7-14, torso/limbs 10-25, lower leg/foot 14-30, joints 14-28; diabetic foot 30-90 days and deep tissue 21-42 days (each multiplied by a body-part factor).
map.按伤口类型与大小修正：类型系数：擦伤 0.7、手术切口 0.85、切割伤 1.0: Adjust by wound type and size: type factors: abrasion 0.7, surgical incision 0.85, cut 1.0, laceration 1.2, burn 1.3; size: small 0.75, medium 1.0, large 1.4 (multiplied).
map.按年龄修正与阶段拆分：年龄系数：儿童 0.8、青年 1.0、中年 1.15、老年: Adjust by age and split into phases: age factors: child 0.8, young adult 1.0, middle-aged 1.15, older adult 1.35. Healing is shown in four phases: inflammation (20%), proliferation (50%), epithelialization (lower bound) and remodeling (upper bound).
map.算例 A：前臂切割伤（中等、青年）: Example A: forearm cut (medium, young adult)
map.前臂 baseDays[10,18]×系数 0.95，切割伤 1.0 × 中 1: Forearm baseDays[10,18] × factor 0.95, cut 1.0 × medium 1.0 × young adult 1.0 → lower bound 10×0.95≈9.5→10 days, upper bound 18×0.95≈17.1→18 days, estimated healing in 10-18 days.
map.算例 B：糖尿病足大伤口（老年、切割伤）: Example B: diabetic foot large wound (older adult, cut)
map.糖尿病足 baseDays[30,90]×系数 1.5，切割伤 1.0 × 大: Diabetic foot baseDays[30,90] × factor 1.5, cut 1.0 × large 1.4 × older adult 1.35 → lower bound 30×1.5×1.0×1.4×1.35≈85→86 days, upper bound 90×1.5×1.0×1.4×1.35≈255→256 days, estimated about 86-256 days (3-8.5 months); strict glucose control and medical care are needed.
map.为什么糖尿病足愈合这么慢？: Why do diabetic foot wounds heal so slowly?
map.高血糖损害血管神经、降低局部血供与免疫力，组织修复能力显著下降，且易感染。必须严: High blood sugar damages blood vessels and nerves, reduces local blood supply and immunity, markedly lowers tissue repair capacity and increases infection risk. Strict glucose control, daily foot checks and a clean wound are essential, and any wound should be seen by a doctor early.
map.怎样促进伤口愈合？: How can I promote wound healing?
map.清创止血、保持适度湿润清洁、均衡蛋白与维生素 C/Zinc 摄入、戒烟、控制基础: Debride and stop bleeding, keep the wound moderately moist and clean, take balanced protein and vitamin C/zinc, quit smoking and control underlying conditions (glucose/blood supply). If signs of infection appear (redness, swelling, heat, pain, discharge, fever), seek care promptly.
